description: Roblox 3D environment / map / level art -- worlds and sets built from Parts/MeshParts/Models with Terrain, lighting, materials and set dressing (lobbies, dungeons, biomes, towns, showcase builds)

meanArtifact.name: default gray-box map
meanArtifact.description: A flat baseplate with a handful of default-Plastic-material Parts placed by hand, default lighting and skybox, no Terrain sculpting, no textures/SurfaceAppearance/PBR materials, no set dressing or props, no intentional composition or focal landmarks, no atmosphere or post-effects -- what a beginner ships by default following a basic building tutorial

greatArtifactHint: An award-quality Roblox environment: intentional composition with framed sightlines and focal landmarks guiding player flow; a reusable modular kit plus dense layered set dressing and props for believability; crafted PBR materials/SurfaceAppearance and texture variation (no default plastic); sculpted Terrain blended with the builds; rich lighting with Atmosphere, fog, color-graded post-effects and placed emissive/point lights for mood; human-scale proportions and readable navigation; and performance via mesh instancing, part reuse and StreamingEnabled
